name: claude-usage-by-chat
description: Claude Code usage in the status bar: 5h and weekly limits, and how much each chat uses. Unofficial, not made by Anthropic.

commands.title: Claude usage: Cost estimate (update the 5h limit, or hide)
Claude usage: Fetch 5h and weekly usage now

claudeUsage.show5hWeek.markdownDescription:
**5h and week.** Your real 5-hour and weekly usage, from Anthropic's server. Click it to fetch now; hover for when each one resets.

![example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ola1707/claude-usage-by-chat/main/images/5h-week.png)

claudeUsage.showChats.markdownDescription:
**chats.** All the chats in this workspace: their usage in the current 5h window, as % of the 5h limit. The number in brackets is how many chats are open.

![example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ola1707/claude-usage-by-chat/main/images/chats.png)

claudeUsage.showChat.markdownDescription:
**chat.** The chat you're in now: its usage in the current 5h window, as % of the 5h limit. Green when small, then yellow, orange and red as it grows. Hover for the whole chat.

![example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ola1707/claude-usage-by-chat/main/images/chat-green.png) ![example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ola1707/claude-usage-by-chat/main/images/chat-orange.png)

claudeUsage.showCpuMemory.markdownDescription:
**CPU and memory** (off by default). CPU and memory of the running chats and of the chat you're in (macOS and Linux). Choose CPU, memory or both in Process Stats below.

![example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ola1707/claude-usage-by-chat/main/images/cpu-memory.png)

claudeUsage.showCostEstimate.markdownDescription:
**cost est.** How far the 5h limit setting is from the real limit. Click it to update the limit.

![example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ola1707/claude-usage-by-chat/main/images/cost-estimate.png)

claudeUsage.limit5h.description: Weighted-token limit for the 5h window. 0: by your plan (Pro 10,000,000; Max 5x 45,000,000; Max 20x 180,000,000). Changes only when you edit it or click cost est → Update.

claudeUsage.limitWeekly.description: Weighted-token limit for the weekly window (placeholder, calibrate).

enumDescriptions: Hide the item (same as turning off Show Cpu Memory)
claudeUsage.processStats.description: What the CPU/memory status bar item of the running chats shows.

claudeUsage.processIncludeChildren.description: Count a chat's child processes (shell commands, MCP servers) in the CPU/memory numbers. Off: only the chat processes themselves.

claudeUsage.processRefreshSeconds.description: How often to update the CPU/memory item (runs ps).

claudeUsage.chatRefreshSeconds.description: How often to recompute the focused chat usage (local logs only, no server call).
